speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for seeing me. To better understand your increasing left knee pain and swelling over the past two months, how would you describe the nature of the pain, and does it occur at rest or only with activity?

speaker: Patient
text: 24-year-old male. The patient reports increasing pain and swelling of the left knee over 2 months. Describes the pain as severe enough to awaken him from sleep on several occasions. States he tried taking ibuprofen with no relief. No family or personal history of significant illnesses.

speaker: Doctor
text: That is concerning; pain severe enough to wake you from sleep suggests a significant inflammatory or mechanical issue. Does the knee feel warm or red to the touch, and have you noticed any locking, giving way, or a specific injury prior to these symptoms?

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Severe pain and swelling in the left knee. I also have Pain intensifying over 2 months, Painful awakenings during night, No relief with ibuprofen.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Juvenile Idiopathic Arthritis (Oligoarticular) or Early-Onset Rheumatoid Arthritis.
REQUEST IMAGES: Knee_Joint_Ultrasound_and_MRI.
REQUEST TEST: ESR, CRP, RF, Anti-CCP, and Knee_Aspiration.
